title: Gravity and Protocol
author: Ansel Blackwood
blurb: Lior Pemberton, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
